cues: Real life does not always keep both clauses in one time.
A mixed conditional takes each clause from a different type.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now: a past cause, with the past perfect, and a present result, with would plus the base verb.
And the other way round: if he were honest, he would not have cheated in the test: a present state, and a past result.
